ToD_A01_M01_VO_S001_004.source_old: Orgrim Doomhammer - Warchief of the Orcish hordes and Ruler of the Blackrock Clan - has ordered us to establish a small outpost on Lordaeron's southern shores.

ToD_A01_M01_VO_S001_005.source_old: To secure the Zul'dare region as Doomhammer demands we will need to construct a Barracks and several Farms to feed the troops.

ToD_A01_M01_VO_S002_001.source_old: We need a huge amount of resources for the needs of the northern campaign. Gather gold and cut down the forest!

ToD_A01_M01_VO_S004_002.source_old: Is it true sir? Have the orcs really made it this far north?

ToD_A01_M01_VO_S004_003.source_old: And the stories? If even half of them are true, how can we possibly defeat them?

ToD_A01_M01_VO_S004_004.source_old: Calm yourselves and stay focused on our task. We are here to investigate the rumors of a suspected Horde presence in the Zul’dare region.

ToD_A01_M01_VO_S005_001.source_old: Damn! We are not prepared for this! We must put out the signal fire immediately, or they will notice us from the ships. Scour the island, slaughter the humans, and don’t let them warn the mainland!
